title: Constraints on ultralight dark matter couplings from orbital perturbations of binary pulsars: code and data products
description:
Code and data products of Constraints on ultralight dark matter couplings from orbital perturbations of binary pulsars (F. Huxhagen and D. López Nacir, in preparation). Using the wideband data of the 50 binary pulsars of the NANOGrav 15-year data set, the paper sets 95% credible upper limits on three couplings of ultralight dark matter between 1e-23 and 1e-18 eV: a linear and a quadratic universal coupling of a scalar field, and a vector field coupled to B−L.

The record contains the production pipeline, the single-pulsar histograms of the upper-limit runs, the combined upper limits (as plain-text tables and NumPy archives), the external bounds and the scripts that draw the figures of the paper. See README.md.
